Title: Microsoft Azure IoT reference architecture available

Body.Content: The Microsoft Azure IoT reference architecture is available as a PDF download. The reference architecture provides guidance for building secure and scalable, device-centric solutions for connecting devices, conducting analysis, and integrating with back-end systems.
